insights.content: Your last two completed cycles were 48 and 52 days long, well above the typical 21-35 day range. Irregular cycles are common with PCOS and worth discussing with your provider.
insights.title: Your cycles appear highly irregular

insights.content: Cramps and fatigue tend to co-occur on the same days, appearing together in 80% of your logged period days. Managing one may help the other.
insights.title: Cramps and fatigue tend to occur together

insights.content: On days following less than 6 hours of sleep, your average symptom severity was 3.4/5 compared to 2.1/5 after 7+ hours. Prioritizing sleep may reduce symptom burden.
insights.title: Lower sleep seems to precede harder days
